home.welcomeBody: The UMPT WORLD OF TOMORROW collects conference proceedings, books and author profiles in one place. Browse by title, explore the alphabetical index, or find the people behind the research.

proceedings.intro: The Projects & Research catalog brings together UMPT initiatives, study contexts and published reports. Each entry links to a project page with a rich context overview and a separate research report.

Browse by title, explore the alphabetical index, or find the people behind the research.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.metaDescription: How the UMPT WORLD OF TOMORROW collects, uses and protects personal information.
privacy.body:
We collect only the information needed to run the library, respond to contact messages, and moderate comments.

We do not sell personal data. Contact us if you want a message or comment removed.

terms.title: Terms
terms.metaDescription: Terms of use for the UMPT WORLD OF TOMORROW website and published content.
terms.body:
Content on this site is provided for research and educational use. Do not misuse the service, attempt unauthorized access, or post unlawful material.

We may update these terms; continued use of the site means you accept the current version.
